notes:
Deal summary: mid-market e-commerce infra team focused on real-time personalized recommendations + chat. Very cost-sensitive; main driver is reducing per-request unit economics while keeping p95 latency under tight SLOs.

Use-case & goals:
- Re-ranking pipeline for product search: embedding + nearest-neighbor + model rerank stage. Need <150ms p95 end-to-end for rerank path at 250-400 QPS.
- Customer chat: contextual session history, avg response tokens ~24, target p95 <120ms for gen path for top-tier users.
- Heavy reuse of session context across requests -> opportunity for KV/prefix caching. Want automatic caching and cache-hit instrumentation.
- Cost target: 2.5-3x reduction in inference $/k tokens vs their current hosted provider via quantization + batching + better routing.

Technical requirements & preferences:
- Prefer dedicated capacity for predictable throughput; open to private VPC for PII/residency controls.
- Must support SSO (SAML) + audit logs + KMS integration. Retention controls for embeddings (30/90 day options).
- Model preferences: small-medium open models for rerank (quantized int8/4) and tuned Llama-family variants for chat. Need fallback model routing for degraded states.
- Perf bench asks: deliver per-model profile (latency by seq length, p50/p95/p99), batching curves (throughput vs batch size), KV cache hit curve, and quantization accuracy delta for int8 and nf4 profiles.
